question: What is the structure of the ten-syllable mantra addressed to Vishnu?
premises: It includes obeisance to Lord Vishnu
inference: The mantra is a ten-syllable formula beginning with om and offering obeisance to Lord Vishnu.
uncertainties: The exact syllable division of the mantra is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Om, obeisance to the blessed Lord Vishnu — this is the ten-syllabled mantra.
